# Species

`jaff.core.Species`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Ordered, name-indexed collection of `Specie` objects.

Species supports look-up by name (`species["H2O"]`), by serialized form
(`species["+/H/H/O"]`), and by integer index (`species[0]`).  The
`ne` parameter on many accessor methods excludes the electron species
(`"e-"`), which is often treated separately in network solvers.

## Constructor

`#!python Species(species=None, check_length=True)`

**Parameters**

**species** : _list[Specie] | list[str] | None, optional_
: Initial species.  Plain strings are converted to `Specie`
    objects with indices assigned in list order.  If `None`, an
    empty catalogue is created (items can be added with `add`).

**check_length** : _bool, optional_
: If `True` (default), the base `Catalogue` verifies that the
    list and name-dict have the same length.  Set to `False` when
    constructing a catalogue from reactants/products that may contain
    duplicate species.

## Properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`configure`](configure.md) | Override the mass dictionary and propagate it to `Specie`. |
| [`add`](add.md) | Append a new species to the catalogue if not already present. |
| [`from_serialized`](from_serialized.md) | Return the species matching the given serialized form. |
| [`from_name`](from_name.md) | Return the species with the given chemical name. |
| [`get_list`](get_list.md) | Return the underlying ordered list of `Specie` objects. |
| [`names`](names.md) | Return a `Vector` of species names. |
| [`masses`](masses.md) | Return a `Vector` of species masses in grams (CGS). |
| [`exploded`](exploded.md) | Return a `Vector` of atom lists (one per species). |
| [`latex`](latex.md) | Return a `Vector` of LaTeX species strings. |
| [`charges`](charges.md) | Return a `Vector` of net charges in units of elementary charge. |
| [`serialized`](serialized.md) | Return a `Vector` of canonical serialized species strings. |
| [`elements`](elements.md) | Return a `Vector` of `Elements` collections (one per species). |
| [`e_idx`](e_idx.md) | Return the integer index of the electron species, or `None`. |
| [`normalized_names`](normalized_names.md) | Return species names normalized for use as code identifiers. |
| [`charge_reverse_map`](charge_reverse_map.md) | Map each species' j/k-normalized identifier back to the `Specie`. |
| [`neutral`](neutral.md) | Return neutral (charge == 0) species or one of their attributes. |
| [`charged`](charged.md) | Return charged (charge != 0) species or one of their attributes. |
| [`charge_truths`](charge_truths.md) | Return a binary `Vector` indicating whether each species is charged. |
